The '''Deltron system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Deltron/Legends|Deltron]], the [[Deltron (species)|Deltron]] homeworld.
